title: Sources: Microsoft is among a group of companies lobbying the Trump administration to halt the FCC's plan to ban imports of Chinese optical transceivers (Alexandra Alper/Reuters)
summary: Alexandra Alper / Reuters: Sources: Microsoft is among a group of companies lobbying the Trump administration to halt the FCC's plan to ban imports of Chinese optical transceivers — Microsoft (MSFT.O) has been pressing the Trump administration to halt plans to bar Chinese imports of a key component used in AI data centers …
